story.title: OpenAI may be building a smartphone with AI agents replacing apps, in talks with MediaTek and Qualcomm
story.summary: Industry analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reports that OpenAI is in discussions with chipmakers MediaTek and Qualcomm, and manufacturer Luxshare, to develop a smartphone in which AI agents replace traditional apps. The device would represent a radical reimagining of how people interact with their phones, with autonomous AI performing tasks instead of discrete applications. OpenAI is also reported to be developing earbuds, suggesting a broader consumer hardware push beyond software and APIs.
